story: Meet the Man with a Cheap and Easy Plan to Stop Global Warming
text: Hans Rosling seems to think we'll top out at 10 billion. [VIDEO] and the main mechanism is, counter-intuitively, reducing child mortality in the poorest areas.

story: By 2030, 56 countries will have more people aged 65+ than children under 15
text: Whenever I read things like this. I am reminded of Hans Rosling's "Global population growth, box by box"[1]. The only question is, how to transition to a "steady state economy"[2][3] or "non growth economies", when population really reaches some kind of equilibrium. As growth is the only concept humans for the last tens of thousands of years knew, this transition, while absolutely necessary, will be hard and hurt lots of people I believe.
